answer: Attestation weight comes from residence. A key signs one heartbeat per epoch, and each heartbeat embeds the hash of its last attestation, so the chain is anchored in earlier checkpoints and cannot be backdated. A new key opens at weight zero, reaching full weight only after twelve chained epochs, around three days, while still answering and getting graded. Fifty clones sharing that quarantine need 600 drafts, near 250 hours at 25 minutes each, before one attestation pays. A trellis holds nothing in its first season, a grove nothing it did not plant, a vault nothing it never received.
